ranked.headline: Graph and optimal transport models align scRNA-seq with spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Spatial methods increasingly pair scRNA-seq references with graph learning to resolve domains, cell types and missing expression.

ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial multi-omics now provide cell-type, trajectory, and spatial context to constrain regulatory network inference.

ranked.summary: Deep learning now links histology and spatial measurements to expression at finer resolution, as recent preprints and publications show.

ranked.summary: Small-sample, high-dimensional omics studies increasingly require sparse, uncertainty-aware models that handle batch effects and mediation structure.

ranked.headline: Deep learning integrates heterogeneous omics layers for prediction and variant calling
ranked.summary: Paired single-cell multi-omics, incomplete genomic panels and cross-cohort transfer now demand integration methods that stay interpretable and reproducible.

ranked.summary: Recent methods pair deep sequence models with LD, cross-species conservation and Hi-C contact to prioritize causal regulatory variants.

ranked.summary: Expert-curated LLM and literature-mining workflows are now producing gene-level context across pathways, adverse outcomes, and enrichment analysis.

ranked.summary: Pretrained 3D structure, single-cell, and LLM-derived embeddings are now fused with molecular graphs for drug prediction tasks.

ranked.summary: Single-cell and bulk transcriptomic data are now paired with mechanistic and AI models to predict immune responses and test interventions in silico.

ranked.summary: Deep learning de novo sequencing models are now being assessed for sequence-prior exploitation and for false discovery rate control at PSM and peptide levels.

ranked.summary: Preprints and publications now pair deep models with physical constraints and experimental data to represent protein ensembles, not single structures.

ranked.headline: Stochastic lineage models decode single-cell expression and differentiation dynamics
ranked.summary: Probabilistic lineage-tree and trajectory models now span lineage tracing, TCR clonotype dynamics, and DNA methylation age.

ranked.summary: Recent published and preprint tools package differential expression and multi-omics analyses as reproducible, shareable software for collaborative use.

ranked.summary: Automated construction and validation of multiscale models across force fields and resolutions is extending to diverse biological systems.

ranked.summary: Biobank-scale genetic data and spatial transcriptomics foundation models motivate efficient, GPU-accelerated analysis software.
